title: Ashokan inscriptions: more edicts, pillars, missions

boxes.title: Identity, titles & limits
items: "Devanampiya Piyadasi" confirmed as Ashoka when **Maski** edict found (**1915**)
**Piyadasi** = of pleasing looks; RE XIV: "engraved by command of King Piyadassi"
Other epithet: ==**Dharmasoka**== (Sarnath inscription)
Kanaganahalli Mahastupa lies near the **Bhima** river
Greek & Aramaic versions: Buddhist ideas but no Buddha named
No edict names Eightfold Path, Four Noble Truths, Nibbana; never varna or sati
Edict form ("lipi/dipi") follows **Darius**'s Persian inscriptions

boxes.title: More edicts → subject
head: Edict
Subject
rows: Animal killing in **royal kitchen** cut; no **samaja** gatherings
Animals not killed; no forest burning

cards.title: Date & cause
lines: Kalinga held east-coast land & sea routes

cards.title: Result
lines: Conversion to Buddhism; no more conquest wars

cards.title: Separate Kalinga edicts
lines: Take the place of RE XI-XIII; RE XIII omitted

boxes.title: Dhamma & reign
items: Reign ==**273-232 BC**==; earlier governor of **Taxila**, **Ujjain**
Moral code; Buddhist ethics, not sectarian (some Zoroastrian strands)
Virtues: kindness, charity, truthfulness, **respect for elders**
PE II: "few faults, many good deeds"; vices: violence, anger, pride

boxes.title: Pillars & extent
items: Lumbini visit after **20th** year (⚠ other notes: 21st); land revenue **one-sixth** → one-eighth
PE VII: **Ajivikas**, **Nirgranthas**; Dhamma spreads by persuasion > law
Meerut → Delhi Ridge: **Firoz Shah Tughlaq**; Kosam → Allahabad fort: **Akbar** (Jahangir added inscription)
Allahabad: Queen **Karuvaki**'s gifts; pillars cluster in Ganga plain (river transport)
Northern limit: **Rajatarangini** - son ==**Jalauka**== in Kashmir
Countries: India, **Bangladesh**, Nepal, Pakistan, Afghanistan

boxes.title: Andhra & RE XIII kings
items: Council at **Pataliputra** under **Moggaliputta Tissa**; list from **Mahavamsa**
Ashoka enlarged ==**Amaravati**== stupa (Mahadeva first built); plaque with his name
Dharanikota sculptures older than **Sanchi**, **Bharhut**
RE XIII (c. **256 BCE**); "Andhra-bhrityas" = Puranic term
Kings: **Antiochus II** (Syria), **Ptolemy II** (Egypt), **Magas** (Cyrene), **Antigonus Gonatas** (Macedonia), Alexander (Epirus)
